title: SK Hynix's IPO prospectus analysis, as it seeks to raise ~$28B on the Nasdaq: highly leveraged to HBM, extensive ties to China, and health and safety issues (Tim Culpan/Culpium)
summary: Tim Culpan / Culpium: SK Hynix's IPO prospectus analysis, as it seeks to raise ~$28B on the Nasdaq: highly leveraged to HBM, extensive ties to China, and health and safety issues — [Opinion] The world's second-largest memory chip maker has more stories than its F-1 filing reveals — SK Hynix is going big in America.
contentText:
Tim Culpan / Culpium :

SK Hynix's IPO prospectus analysis, as it seeks to raise ~$28B on the Nasdaq: highly leveraged to HBM, deep and broad China ties, and health and safety concerns   —  [Opinion] The world's second-largest memory chip maker has more stories than its F-1 filing reveals  —  SK Hynix is going big in America.
